about.title: About PookieCrafts
about.subtitle: Where simple things feel a little more special.
about.howItStarted: Pookie Crafts is your little escape.
about.howItStartedText1: This isn't just about what you buy. It's about how it makes you feel. Pookie Crafts was created to bring a little calm into everyday life -- through simple things like journaling, soft light, and quiet time for yourself.
about.howItStartedText2: A cozy night. A calm mind. A moment just for you. Start your ritual and make it yours.
about.handmadeQualityText: Every product is crafted by hand in small batches to ensure the highest quality.
about.naturalMaterialsText: We use eco-friendly, sustainable materials whenever possible.
about.madeWithLoveText: Each item is created with care and attention to detail.
about.joinCommunityText: We're so grateful to have a wonderful community of customers who appreciate handmade quality and thoughtful design. Every order supports a small business and helps us continue doing what we love. Thank you for being part of our journey!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about our products
faq.q1: How long does the shipping take?
faq.a1: Orders are usually processed within 1-3 business days. Delivery time depends on your location, but we aim to get your package to you as quickly as possible.
faq.a2: Currently, we ship within the EU only and we offer free shipping.
faq.q3: What are the candles made from?
faq.a3: All our candles are from 100% natural soy wax, premium fragrance oils and cotton wicks.
faq.q4: Do the candles include real crystals?
faq.a4: Yes -- each candle includes real crystals, thoughtfully placed to complement the mood and aesthetic of the piece.
faq.stillQuestionsText: We're here to help! Feel free to reach out to us.

returnsPage.title: Returns & refunds
returnsPage.subtitle: A simple and fair process for your peace of mind.
returnsPage.p1: If you're not satisfied with your order, you can return it within 14 days of delivery. The product must be unused and in its original condition.
returnsPage.p2: For claims, please contact us as soon as possible and include your order number with a short description of the issue.
returnsPage.p3: After approval, we'll send return instructions. Shipping costs depend on the claim type and local regulations.
